notes.title: NAL Is Alive is alive
notes.notes:
NAL Is Alive is alive

An update for NAL Is Alive is now out, which fixes the issues that prohibited the Launcher from working as intended.

NAL Is Alive now also contains five more games:
[list]
[*] Gossamer Girls: a low-resolution procedurally generated dungeon crawler where you harvest silk from spiders and hunt down upgrades to keep yourself alive
[*] Britskrieg: take control of four plucky Britons in a bid to take over the world at the behest of the Queen
[*] Ink Idiom: the full version of the paid game, solve over 300 visual puzzles that lead to common idioms, sayings and turns of phrase
[*] Rev%lver: take control of a gun with a weird habit of wasting ammunition if you answer percentage-based trivia questions too inaccurately
[*] Jasmine Laslo – Switch U On: fall for an MLM music streaming service which only has one song available – the owner’s daughter’s – generating a million plays for her incessantly terrible song
[/list]

The highscores are currently misbehaving, but I wanted to get a version out that AT LEAST makes the compilation work to a fundamental degree again.

I believe an apology is owed, as well. For the time NAL Is Alive took for me to create, it didn’t exactly set the world on fire (infact it lost us money through the fact I spent time on it and not on more fruitful things) so I definitely wasn’t enthusiastic to continue working on it. Unfortunately, working on it becomes a little more pressing when it decides it’s just going to up and die.

Fixing it has been exacerbated by a number of issues – the launcher’s file relies on a specific extension to actually run the games of NAL Is Alive, and for some reason, versions of GameMaker released since I last worked on NIA shot the extension dead. It is only thanks to the extremely helpful YellowAfterlife, and his extension that I found could swap it out without a world of hassle, for me being able to get the launcher working again THIS soon. (The error that broke the launcher in the first place was not the result of any update and I genuinely have no idea why it suddenly turned from “not existing” into “broadly problematic”.)

So I’m really sorry it’s taken this long. I’m writing this at 2:15am on a Saturday night (well, Sunday morning) resuscitating this dumb compilation, and I hope the few of you that care about it are now able to play it, enjoy it, and play around with it.

Thank you from the bottom of my heart for your patience, I don’t deserve any of you. If this kind of error ever happens again I’m going to hit it with a big stick and possibly cry or something.

- NAL

notes.title: Mar 23rd Patch - Adds 162 Unreleased, Unfinished & Tech Demo Projects
notes.notes:
The latest version of NAL Is Alive is here, enabling "Pandora's Box", a collection of NAL's unreleased games, tech demos and unfinished projects.

Most of these are minuscule in size and few are truly playable, but in all, Pandora's Box contains 162 new things to try out. More tech demos will be added, along with a big handful of alpha, beta and pre-alpha versions of complete games.

There will also be extra information for each of the things in Pandora's Box added soon to improve sorting through the list.

notes.title: Jan 11th Patch
notes.notes:
Now live, does the following:

Titan Tighten: If you complete the game and then play again immediately, your screw count will return to 0
Titan Tighten: Scores are now measured in milliseconds, not seconds
Terminal Velocity 2: Scores reset when you exit to menu and play again

PLEASE NOTE: Titan Tighten is the first (and currently only) game to receive an upgraded method of saving games; as a result, your progress for the game if you have already played it will be erased.

This is a change that will work its way through the entire library of games in NAL Is Alive over time, so please bear that in mind - it will only happen once for each game, and we'll note which games receive this change in patchnotes as it occurs. This does not affect Steam achievements, though - if you have earnt achievements for game completion, they will remain achieved.

notes.title: Jan 2nd 2017 Patch
notes.notes:
Hey all, hope you've had a good holiday and a happy new year!

A new patch for NAL Is Alive is live now, which does the following:

- Fixes an issue with the time that Innoquous 4's completion trophies unlock
- Fixes the ordering of Innoquous 1's Speedrun leaderboard so that faster times are now better

It also adds FKR11, the latest in NAL's yearly FKR series, along with NIA leaderboards. For now, FKR11 is exclusive to NAL Is Alive - and the version released later on stand-alone will not have the online leaderboards of the NIA version, so you're getting the best version first!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26745812/122e9d61f591257c17478a4e4955d12d75a7889c.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26745812/2dc858216ddbd8c9ec25b8db419293c9254c4dd9.png[/img]

Anyway, if you have any extra holidays off, we hope they serve you well. We're back to work now, so work on NIA is now officially resumed!

notes.title: First Early Access version launching December 17th!
notes.notes:
We're pleased to announce that the initial launch of NAL Is Alive in Early Access will be on the 17th of December - this Saturday!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26745812/6fde6f75211a9c52329c3059b5d287712189cd75.png[/img]

All 132 games included with this build will be playable (although 3 suffer some issues that halt gameplay).

Of those, 85 feature statistics that sync with the launcher, including online leaderboards in most cases - see how you fare when your highscores, speedruns and other general victories are compared with the world. There are around 200 online leaderboards available across all games in the first version of NAL Is Alive, with plenty more to come.

There are also 74 achievements across the games, again with hundreds more to come in the future.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26745812/30dbd51e04a3953c85190243bf994e5bc236ee49.png[/img]

Over the holiday period we'll be continuing to address major issues, with full work resuming at the beginning of 2017 with the aim of a full, final release planned towards the end of 2017.

As usual, if you have any queries about the game (or the 132 games!), we'll be happy to answer them! You can find a full list of games included in NAL Is Alive here: steamcommunity.com/games/485430/announcements/detail/585862253597591941

notes.title: Early Access release planned for as soon as possible
notes.notes:
As an update, we're looking to have NAL Is Alive out in an Early Access version as soon as possible - ideally by the end of 2016.

This is largely due to the music used in many of the older games only being usable in non-commercial settings, and needing replacement. As we do this, we then also need to make them compatible with newer game development programs (they were built in versions of GameMaker as much as 13 years old).

Once that is rectified, we can release NAL Is Alive in an early form, as we then begin the process of beautifying everything one game at a time and making the more basic/silly games a lot more enjoyable.

Plenty of the games included already have Steam Leaderboard and launcher-based statistics support, though, which is great - and those systems will also be able to tie into easily implementing a very, very wide array of achievements at a later date.

Thanks for your patience, and we're happy to answer any questions about the game.
